notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
smtp-open-relay NSE tests 16 different relay bypass techniques in a single run. A result of 16/16 is a confirmed open relay — the server will forward email from any sender to any recipient, enabling phishing with spoofed trusted addresses.

=== OPEN RELAY IMPACT ===
Send email appearing to originate from internal@company.com or ceo@company.com. Bypasses SPF checks if receiving server trusts the relay. Enables targeted phishing, spam campaigns, mail spoofing.

=== mynetworks MISCONFIGURATION ===
Postfix mynetworks = 0.0.0.0/0 allows any IP to relay. Should be restricted to localhost and internal mail infrastructure only.
